content: .{@-स्थ@} {%a.%} .²1 standing at the top, occupying the highest place (said of a person who stands at the head in a genealogical table). .²2 silent; not at all moving or working; <ls>Mb. 12. 179. 6</ls>. ({@-स्थः@}) the Supreme Soul (immovable, unchangeable, and perpetually the same); क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते <ls>Bg. 6. 8</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">12. 3.</ls> . ({@-स्थः@}, {@-स्थम्@}) a kind of perfume (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>नखला</ns>).
